A single candidate thermal anomaly: one suspicious region detected inside a
ThermalInspection's image, paired with an AI-written cautious explanation.
The bounding box (ThermalAnomaly#xPct …) is derived from the actual image
pixels on the client; the prose fields (ThermalAnomaly#observation …) are
generated by ThermalInspection#analyze. A recorded anomaly is a
screening observation to verify, not a confirmed defect.
